description: WattCoin: Withdraw WATT from your agent ledger to your attached wallet. IRREVERSIBLE: the balance is debited at once and a payout is queued. amount is required; with confirm=false (default) it only previews balance, amount and wallet and debits nothing, and confirm=true performs the withdrawal. The minimum is set by the backend (see its error message or docs). Needs agent_key and a wallet from set_agent_wallet. Check payout status with get_agent_profile view=withdrawals.

agent_key.description: Your WattCoin agent API key, format wck_..., returned once by register_agent.

amount.description: WATT to withdraw, whole number (e.g. 100). Required; there is no full-balance default

confirm.description: Default false = preview only, nothing debited. true = debit and queue the payout

name: withdraw_earnings
title: WattCoin: Withdraw earnings
